text:
Maria - CSM: Hey team + @Talia — kicking off Sparrow Grove onboarding. Quick agenda: stakeholders, success criteria, 14/30/60 timeline, enablement sessions, compliance flags, and renewal risks. Can folks confirm owners for each area? :tada:
Talia - Sparrow Grove: Thanks Maria — excited to get started. I'm Sparrow Grove's product lead. Primary success metric is reducing average response time in-app from ~2.8s to <1.2s for our top 5 flows. We'll share sample prompts and traffic mix this afternoon.
Jon - Solutions Eng: I'll own model integration + the test harness. Need sandbox API keys, service account access, and sample traffic. Can someone grant `sgonboard-svc` role? I propose a 14-day sprint to get gen flows wired into staging.
Kevin - Enablement: I'll run two enablement sessions: dev onboarding (code walkthrough) and admin ops (dashboards/RBAC). Proposed slots: next Wed 11am PT and Thu 9am PT. Which works for Sparrow Grove decision makers?
Talia - Sparrow Grove: Decision makers are Arun (PM) and me for UX signoff. Arun prefers Thu mornings.
Arun - Sparrow Grove PM: Confirm Thu morning works. Also flagging a compliance review — we need audit logs, data residency confirmation, and a short list of retention policies before we go prod.
onboard-bot: Created tasks in the onboarding board: 1) Sandbox keys, 2) Sample traffic upload, 3) Compliance checklist, 4) Enablement invites, 5) 14d plan doc. (Assignee: Maria)
Priya - Success Ops: I'll own the renewal-risk tracker and baseline spend calc. Note: contract upsell hinge is a 6-month SLA and usage efficiency metrics. I'll add monitoring alerts to watch token spend variance >15% vs baseline.
Maria - CSM: Adding initial success criteria (draft):
```
- Integration deployed to sandbox with synthetic tests passing
- Latency: 95th pctl < 1.2s on top-5 flows at baseline load
- Cost: acceptable unit cost per request (<baseline + 10%)
- Two enablement sessions completed and recordings shared
- Compliance checklist items: audit logs, retention policy, KMS confirmed
- Go/no-go playbook and rollback defined
```
Jon - Solutions Eng: For the harness, can Sparrow Grove share a 1k-sample of production traffic (anonymized)? Also planning for batching & caching — sample config below: 
```
batch_size: 8
max_latency_ms: 50
kv_cache: enabled
```
Kevin - Enablement: I'll send invites now (placeholders). Will include recordings, slide deck, and a short lab. Can someone confirm who should get admin access to the console?
Arun - Sparrow Grove PM: Please grant console admin to `talia@sg.com` and `arun@sg.com`. I'll work with my security lead to run the compliance checklist. Also adding acceptance criteria: 95th pctl < 1.2s on a 1k-rps spike with caching disabled for verification.
Talia - Sparrow Grove: Thanks — we'll upload traffic and the baseline report by EOD. Weekly sync cadence? Fri 10am PT works for our team.
Maria - CSM: Weekly sync Fri 10am PT. Next steps: Maria to post 14d sprint plan and calendar invites, Jon to request sandbox roles, Kevin to finalize enablement material, Priya to add renewal-monitoring alerts. Any blockers — drop them here. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
